channel.desc: Kidney disease and benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) are common health concerns, but understanding them is key to managing your well-being. Join us on this episode of Ultimate Prescription, as we break down the physiology and causes behind kidney disease and BPH, discuss effective management and diagnoses, and explore how nutrition and natural remedies can support kidney and prostate health.
